import sys

def max_expression_value(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp_max = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    dp_min = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]

    # Initialize the diagonal with single digit values
    for i in range(0, n, 2):
        dp_max[i][i] = int(s[i])
        dp_min[i][i] = int(s[i])

    # Fill the dp tables
    for length in range(3, n + 1, 2):  # length of the segment
        for i in range(0, n - length + 1, 2):
            j = i + length - 1
            for k in range(i + 1, j, 2):
                if s[k] == '+':
                    dp_max[i][j] = max(dp_max[i][j], dp_max[i][k-1] + dp_max[k+1][j])
                    dp_min[i][j] = min(dp_min[i][j], dp_min[i][k-1] + dp_min[k+1][j])
                else:  # s[k] == '*'
                    dp_max[i][j] = max(dp_max[i][j], dp_max[i][k-1] * dp_max[k+1][j])
                    dp_min[i][j] = min(dp_min[i][j], dp_min[i][k-1] * dp_min[k+1][j])

    return dp_max[0][n-1]

def max_expression_value(s):
    n = len(s)
    nums = [int(s[i]) for i in range(0, n, 2)]
    ops = [s[i] for i in range(1, n, 2)]
    
    def evaluate(left, right, op):
        if op == '+':
            return left + right
        else:
            return left * right
    
    # dp_max[i][j] will store the maximum value of the expression from nums[i] to nums[j]
    # dp_min[i][j] will store the minimum value of the expression from nums[i] to nums[j]
    dp_max = [[0] * len(nums) for _ in range(len(nums))]
    dp_min = [[0] * len(nums) for _ in range(len(nums))]
    
    # Initialize the dp arrays for single elements
    for i in range(len(nums)):
        dp_max[i][i] = nums[i]
        dp_min[i][i] = nums[i]
    
    # Fill the dp arrays
    for length in range(2, len(nums) + 1):  # length of the sub-expression
        for i in range(len(nums) - length + 1):
            j = i + length - 1
            dp_max[i][j] = float('-inf')
            dp_min[i][j] = float('inf')
            for k in range(i, j):
                op = ops[k]
                val1 = evaluate(dp_max[i][k], dp_max[k+1][j], op)
                val2 = evaluate(dp_max[i][k], dp_min[k+1][j], op)
                val3 = evaluate(dp_min[i][k], dp_max[k+1][j], op)
                val4 = evaluate(dp_min[i][k], dp_min[k+1][j], op)
                dp_max[i][j] = max(dp_max[i][j], val1, val2, val3, val4)
                dp_min[i][j] = min(dp_min[i][j], val1, val2, val3, val4)
    
    return dp_max[0][-1]

def max_expression_value(s):
    n = len(s)
    dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Base case: single digit
    for i in range(0, n, 2):
        dp[i][i][0] = int(s[i])
        dp[i][i][1] = int(s[i])
    
    # Fill the DP table
    for length in range(3, n + 1, 2):  # length of the segment
        for i in range(0, n - length + 1, 2):
            j = i + length - 1
            for k in range(i + 1, j, 2):
                if s[k] == '+':
                    dp[i][j][0] = max(dp[i][j][0], dp[i][k-1][0] + dp[k+1][j][0])
                    dp[i][j][1] = max(dp[i][j][1], dp[i][k-1][1] + dp[k+1][j][1])
                else:
                    dp[i][j][0] = max(dp[i][j][0], dp[i][k-1][0] * dp[k+1][j][0])
                    dp[i][j][1] = max(dp[i][j][1], dp[i][k-1][1] * dp[k+1][j][1])
    
    return dp[0][n-1][1]
